name: finance_spend
description: Answer a personal-finance spending question by querying the user's own bank transactions (via the local Plaid pipeline). Returns a short formatted summary of how much was spent, optionally filtered to one spending category and one time window. Use this for ANY question about the user's spending, e.g. 'how much did I spend on dining last 7 days', 'total this month', 'groceries this week'.

category.description: The spending category to filter by. Use 'all' when the user does not name a category.

window.description: The time window to summarize. Map natural phrases: 'today'->today, 'this week'/'last 7 days'->last_7_days, 'this month'/'month to date'->mtd, 'last 30 days'->last_30_days.
